about.title: Biblical Study Panel
about.subtitle: Exegesis, Sermons, Devotional and Theological Chat with local AI
about.dedication_text: This application was made by someone who does not understand much about programming, but gave his best. I am a small programmer and IT support who cannot travel to preach the gospel, but I hope that through this tool it will be possible to help many brothers and sisters to meditate and understand the Word of God.
about.church: Member of Nova Igreja Batista, City of Manaus, Amazonas, where I learned that the Word of God is very important for each one of us.
about.verse_phil: "I can do all things through Him who strengthens me."
about.verse_john: "I came that they may have life, and have it abundantly."
about.encouragement_body: Remember: this life is temporary. Our goal is Christ, and He is the only one who has life — life in abundance. May this tool be a light for those who seek the truth.
about.purpose: For those who cannot carry a physical Bible in their hands, for those who do not have freedom of speech, know that the Word of God never returns empty.
about.translation_note: If somewhere the translation is not good, we apologize. We are always looking to improve. If you find any bug or poorly translated text, please report it on GitHub.
about.thanks: May God bless your reading and meditation on the Word. Soli Deo Gloria.
